title: The retained frontier has three different outcomes.
summary: Independent replay finds three checkpoint continuations, two necessary-progress exclusions and eleven unresolved misses among all 16 distinct late states. No probe is time-censored. Full scalar replay checks 621 states and 4,057,614 point-state classifications.
boundary: Checkpoint continuations are not full route completions. Exclusions apply to the declared numerical progress bound; finite misses do not prove infeasibility. Integrated qualification remains 3/4, source comparison closed, and actual-history intervention unestablished.
next: Compare constant and stepwise local proposals on all retained roots under the same 128-transition allowance. Separate local capability from expansion allocation before one integrated change; preserve total budgets and count lost successes.
